summary: Comprehensive testing of JasprChain L1 blockchain after DEX removal and Staking addition. All 27 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend fully functional with all navigation, staking, wallet, validators, blocks, sentinel, and mempool pages working correctly. Token symbol correctly shows $JSP throughout.
passed_tests: Backend API Tests (27/27 passed):
- Health endpoint returns chain_id=1, status=healthy
- Network stats shows 4 validators, TPS, finality metrics
- TPS endpoint returns target_tps=10000
- Get all validators returns 4 validators (Jaspr Labs, Foundation, Community, Ecosystem)
- Get single validator by address works
- Non-existent validator returns 404
- Staking validators endpoint returns APY for each validator (~9.5%)
- Staking stats overview shows total_staked, average_apy, unbonding_period=14 days
- Stake tokens to validator works
- Unstake tokens from validator works
- Stake with insufficient balance returns 400
- Unstake with insufficient stake returns 400
- Create MPC wallet returns address, public_key, threshold=2-of-3
- Get wallet details shows balance, AA wallet info, stakes
- Get wallet balance shows 1000 JSP initial balance
- Get blocks list works
- Get genesis block (height=0) works
- Non-existent block returns 404
- Sentinel status shows guard_mode=enforced
- Sentinel stats shows total_scanned, threats_detected
- Sentinel quarantine endpoint works
- Set sentinel mode works (passive/warning/enforced)
- Mempool stats shows pending, by_lane, total_gas
- Transfer transaction creates pending tx
- Token symbol shows $JSP not JJ in wallet balance
- Token symbol shows $JSP in staking stats
- Token symbol shows $JSP in validators stake
Frontend Tests (All Passed):
- Dashboard loads with network stats, recent blocks, validators, sentinel status
- Staking page shows 4 validators with APY (9.5-9.7%)
- Validator selection shows stake form with estimated APY
- Stake/Unstake buttons work
- Amount input accepts $JSP values
- Wallet creation works (MPC Protected badge visible)
- Wallet shows 1000.0000 JSP balance
- Send form with recipient and amount inputs
- Account Abstraction section shows session keys, guardians, 2FA
- Block Explorer shows blocks list with height, hash, proposer, txns
- Block detail shows timestamp, proposer, state roots
- Validators page shows all 4 validators with stake in $JSP
- AI Sentinel page shows guard mode selector (Passive/Warning/Enforced)
- Sentinel shows quarantined transactions, risk distribution
- Mempool page shows pending txs, lane distribution, lane priority info
- Navigation between all pages works correctly
- End-to-end staking flow: Create wallet -> Navigate to staking -> Select validator -> Stake tokens -> Success message shown
critical_code_review_comments: All core L1 features working correctly after DEX removal
Token symbol correctly changed from JJ to $JSP throughout
Dynamic APY calculation working (varies by validator based on stake share)
MPC wallet and Account Abstraction features functional
AI Sentinel with guard modes working
Mempool with lane-based transaction prioritization working
